case_title: JUGUT RAM v. THE STATE OF CHHATTISGARH
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 302 IPC and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The accused assaulted the victim with a lathi on the head during a land dispute. The victim did not die immediately but succumbed to his injuries in the hospital the following day. The post mortem report indicated that the injuries caused by the lathi were dangerous to life. Other injured witnesses confirmed that the accused also suffered injuries during the incident. The High Court concluded that the assault was not premeditated but occurred in a heat of passion due to the land dispute. The accused had already served the maximum period of sentence prescribed under the conviction and was directed to be set at liberty.
